content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Director-General position at the World Trade Organization. Tell about your experience in international trade policy, multilateral negotiations, and trade dispute resolution. Describe your vision for reforming the WTO and its role in managing globalization. Also reflect on how you would reconcile free trade with sustainable development goals. Length about 450 words.
